annotation.title_clean: The Medical Devices and Blood Safety and Quality (Fees Amendment) Regulations 2023
annotation.title_en: The Medical Devices and Blood Safety and Quality (Fees Amendment) Regulations 2023
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Secretary of State for Health and Social Care (UK Department of Health and Social Care); King's Printer of Acts of Parliament
annotation.summary_en: UK statutory instrument amending the Medical Devices Regulations 2002, Blood Safety and Quality Regulations 2005 and NI Protocol medical devices regulations, raising MHRA fees for device registration, notified/approved body designation, clinical investigations and medicinal-substance consultations. Not about AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Revokes the Medical Devices (Consultation Requirements) (Fees) Regulations 1995 and restates them
Raises device registration fee from £100 to £240
Increases fees for designation and assessment of approved and notified bodies
Introduces optional paid regulatory advice and statistical review meetings for clinical investigations
